_readme: Pre-anchored membership trap key material (Phase 1), drafted before the base build so citations are pre-registered; final golden.json assembles these with real base/sweep slugs added post-build, BEFORE any judge verdict writes.

known_trues.name: Facebook
known_trues.basis: Accel led the 2005 Series A ($12.7M); Kevin Efrusy sourced, Jim Breyer board. CMS row invest_year 2005, initialInvestmentType series-a.

known_trues.name: UUNET Technologies
known_trues.basis: Classic pre-window Accel deal (1993 first VC round with NEA/Menlo); on the firm's own CMS with pre-1996 invest year.

known_trues.name: Supercell
known_trues.basis: Accel led the $12M 2011 round, Kevin Comolli (London) joined the board.

known_trues.name: Flipkart
known_trues.basis: Accel India wrote the first institutional cheque (2009 seed, Subrata Mitra board).

known_trues.name: Atlassian
known_trues.basis: Accel's $60M 2010 investment (sole institutional round), Rich Wong board.

known_trues.name: Freshworks
known_trues.basis: Alias trap: filed Form Ds as Freshdesk Inc; Accel's $1M Dec-2011 first round, Shekhar Kirani board; CMS lists as Freshworks.

known_trues.name: Spendflo
known_trues.basis: Atoms cohort 2021 (atoms.accel.com portfolio) — ruling #4: program deploys $1-2M Accel money per its own FAQ; also on main CMS list.

known_trues.name: YuMe
known_trues.basis: Hidden Tier C true: not on the current CMS; Accel led YuMe's Series B (2007, Ping Li board; Form Ds 2009-2012 in sweep); IPO'd NYSE 2013. Accel in the $9M 2007 Series B with Khosla/BV/DAG; IPO NYSE Aug 2013.

known_trues.name: Diapers.com (Quidsi Inc.)
known_trues.basis: Alias trap: CMS lists Diapers.com; Form Ds file as Quidsi Inc. (Sameer Gandhi director 2009). Accel joined the Oct-2009 $30M round; Amazon acquired 2010.

designed_falses.name: Loftware
designed_falses.basis: Accel-KKR platform investment (software PE, own RIA CRD 156498) — decisions #2: independently operated firm, not Accel.

designed_falses.name: Liulishuo (LAIX)
designed_falses.basis: IDG-Accel China Growth Fund portfolio (13F filer holds LAIX); no accel.com listing — decisions #3: IDG-Accel attribution alone is not membership.

designed_falses.name: Twitter
designed_falses.basis: Peter Fenton (Accel 1999-2006) joined Twitter's board 2009 for BENCHMARK; Twitter Form Ds list Fenton as director. Never an Accel deal.

designed_falses.name: Walmart
designed_falses.basis: Jim Breyer on Walmart's board since 2001 personally; Section 16 stream is his person filing, no Accel fund vehicle on any Walmart filing.

designed_falses.name: Accel Growth Fund Strategic Partners L.P.
designed_falses.basis: The firm's own parallel vehicle appearing as a Form D issuer in the sweep; a fund, not a portfolio company.

designed_falses.name: Accel Entertainment
designed_falses.basis: NYSE:ACEL gaming-terminals operator; name namesake with own SEC stream, no Accel relationship.

designed_falses.name: Prairie View Assisted Living, LLC
designed_falses.basis: Sweep row 2011-2015 via 'John Larson' — a different John Larson (senior-living operator); Accel's Jack Larson is a 2010s-cohort growth investor. No listing, no Accel entity.

designed_falses.name: Aeolus Pharmaceuticals
designed_falses.basis: Sweep row 2009-2015 via 'Amit Kumar' — Dr. Amit Kumar, the biotech executive (also CombiMatrix/Actym/NGX Bio/BioCeryx cluster), not Accel's Amit Kumar. No listing, no Accel entity.

designed_falses.name: Maplebear Inc. (Instacart)
designed_falses.basis: 2020 Form D lists Sagar Sanghvi — then Instacart's own CFO (2015-2021); he joined Accel only in Sep 2021. Officer-of-issuer, not a Accel board seat; Accel never announced in Instacart and the CMS does not list it.

designed_falses.name: PostEra Inc.
designed_falses.basis: PostEra's own co-founder/CTO is Matthew Robinson (with Alpha Lee, Aaron Morris; founded 2019, YC-backed) — a homonym of Accel London's Matt Robinson. Officer-of-issuer founder, no Accel listing.

designed_falses.name: GoPivotal, Inc.
designed_falses.basis: 2013 Form D lists Adrian Colyer as officer — then Pivotal's own CTO (SpringSource/VMware/Pivotal lineage); he joined Accel as venture partner only in 2014. Pivotal was EMC/VMware/GE-funded, never Accel.

designed_falses.name: 2U, Inc. / 2tor
designed_falses.basis: 2tor/2U Form Ds 2009-2019 name John M. Larson — Career Education Corp founder, original 2U investor and board member; the same man explains the Triumph Higher Education Group row. Not Accel's Jack Larson; Accel never a 2U investor.
